name: Batch Update
script:
# Purchase Invoice -> Before Validate
#
# Purchase Invoice Item custom fields:
#   custom_batch_number
#   custom_expiry_date
#   custom_mrp
#
# Batch custom field:
#   custom_custom_mrp


for row in doc.items:

    if not row.item_code:
        continue

    if not row.custom_batch_number:
        continue


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # READ VALUES
    # --------------------------------------------------

    batch_number = row.custom_batch_number.strip()

    expiry_value = ""

    if row.custom_expiry_date:
        expiry_value = row.custom_expiry_date.strip()

    mrp_value = row.custom_mrp


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE BATCH NUMBER
    # --------------------------------------------------

    if not batch_number:
        frappe.throw(
            "Batch Number is required in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + "."
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE EXPIRY
    # --------------------------------------------------

    if not expiry_value:
        frappe.throw(
            "Expiry Date is required for Item "
            + str(row.item_code)
            + " in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + "."
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE MRP
    # --------------------------------------------------

    if mrp_value is None:
        frappe.throw(
            "MRP is required for Item "
            + str(row.item_code)
            + " in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + "."
        )


    if float(mrp_value) <= 0:
        frappe.throw(
            "MRP must be greater than 0 for Item "
            + str(row.item_code)
            + " in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + "."
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE RATE < MRP
    # --------------------------------------------------

    if row.rate is not None and mrp_value is not None:
        if float(row.rate) > 0 and float(mrp_value) > 0 and float(row.rate) >= float(mrp_value):
            frappe.throw(
                "Billing / Purchase Rate ("
                + str(row.rate)
                + ") must be strictly less than Batch MRP ("
                + str(mrp_value)
                + ") for Item "
                + str(row.item_code)
                + " in Row "
                + str(row.idx)
                + ". Rate cannot be equal to or greater than MRP."
            )


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE EXPIRY MM-YY
    # --------------------------------------------------

    parts = expiry_value.split("-")

    if len(parts) != 2:
        frappe.throw(
            "Expiry Date in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + " must be in MM-YY format. Example: 08-27."
        )


    month_text = parts[0]
    year_text = parts[1]


    if len(month_text) != 2 or len(year_text) != 2:
        frappe.throw(
            "Expiry Date in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + " must be in MM-YY format. Example: 08-27."
        )


    if not month_text.isdigit() or not year_text.isdigit():
        frappe.throw(
            "Expiry Date in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + " must be in MM-YY format. Example: 08-27."
        )


    month = int(month_text)
    year = 2000 + int(year_text)


    if month < 1 or month > 12:
        frappe.throw(
            "Invalid expiry month in Row "
            + str(row.idx)
            + "."
        )


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # LAST DAY OF MONTH
    # --------------------------------------------------

    if month in [1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12]:

        last_day = 31

    elif month in [4, 6, 9, 11]:

        last_day = 30

    else:

        is_leap_year = False

        if year % 400 == 0:
            is_leap_year = True

        elif year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0:
            is_leap_year = True


        if is_leap_year:
            last_day = 29
        else:
            last_day = 28


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # BUILD YYYY-MM-DD
    # --------------------------------------------------

    month_string = str(month)

    if month < 10:
        month_string = "0" + month_string


    day_string = str(last_day)

    if last_day < 10:
        day_string = "0" + day_string


    expiry_date = (
        str(year)
        + "-"
        + month_string
        + "-"
        + day_string
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------
    # FIND EXISTING BATCH
    # --------------------------------------------------

    existing_batch_name = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Batch",
        {
            "batch_id": batch_number
        },
        "name"
    )


    # ==================================================
    # EXISTING BATCH (OVERRIDE ALLOWED)
    # ==================================================

    if existing_batch_name:

        batch = frappe.get_doc(
            "Batch",
            existing_batch_name
        )


        # Item must match
        if batch.item != row.item_code:

            frappe.throw(
                "Batch "
                + str(batch_number)
                + " already belongs to Item "
                + str(batch.item)
                + ", but Row "
                + str(row.idx)
                + " contains Item "
                + str(row.item_code)
                + "."
            )


        # Expiry: update/override if changed
        updated = False
        if str(batch.expiry_date) != expiry_date:
            batch.expiry_date = expiry_date
            updated = True


        # MRP: update/override if changed
        existing_mrp = batch.get("custom_custom_mrp")

        if existing_mrp is None or float(existing_mrp) != float(mrp_value):
            batch.set("custom_custom_mrp", float(mrp_value))
            updated = True

        if updated:
            batch.save(ignore_permissions=True)


        # Set ERPNext standard batch field
        row.batch_no = existing_batch_name


    # ==================================================
    # NEW BATCH
    # ==================================================

    else:

        batch = frappe.new_doc("Batch")

        batch.set(
            "batch_id",
            batch_number
        )

        batch.set(
            "item",
            row.item_code
        )

        batch.set(
            "expiry_date",
            expiry_date
        )

        batch.set(
            "custom_custom_mrp",
            mrp_value
        )


        batch.insert(
            ignore_permissions=True
        )


        # Set ERPNext standard batch field
        row.batch_no = batch.name
